scope: Full serialized content of 2018_5.zip, 2018_7.zip and 2018_8.zip only. No June 2018 archive is present in the supplied inventory.

method.interpretation_notes: Findings and independent-reconciliation results are added to the full scan controls without changing raw serialized metrics.

interpretation_limits: Archive month, report date and trade date are separate. Daily histograms are observed stored dates, not proof of complete exchange sessions.
TR_TYPE(*), settlement, delay, instrument, report-type and amendment codes remain opaque. No buy/sell, revision precedence, stable longitudinal identifier or direction semantics inferred.
VALUE (in Rs) gives a rupee unit. RATE and QUANTITY do not supply a full instrument-specific pricing convention. RATE sums and QUANTITY sums are audit controls, not economic net flows.
RATE*QUANTITY residuals are diagnostics only. Finite source-rate precision, instrument conventions, or reporting differences may matter; no values were repaired.
Candidate-key repetition and ISIN syntax/checksum diagnostics do not establish authoritative identities, duplicates to delete, or corporate-action equivalence.

All serialized content read is distinct from source authenticity, native feature behavior, historical continuity, consumer equivalence, current provider readiness, Mongo coverage, or trading suitability.
Raw source identifiers remain in the original workbook only. Evidence retains counts and bounded sheet/cell/row locators.

independent_reconciliation.reader: Independent root lxml streaming parser and Decimal arithmetic
independent_reconciliation.note: Different parser implementations agree on source and package pins, sheet structure, field types, shared strings, daily/lag/code histograms, exact numeric controls, residuals, and ISIN diagnostics. Raw and trim-only duplicate definitions differ; the compared custodian+transaction and whole-record counts are zero under both definitions.

findings: May and August use the 19 named fields in A:S. July uses B:T plus an unlabelled A ordinal; all 106,929 ordinal values equal Excel row minus one. Do not treat that ordinal as a transaction identifier.

RFDE_CUST_REG_NUM and RFDE_TXN_ID contain both numeric and shared-string cells in every workbook. Preserve their source types and lexical values; within-file key diagnostics do not establish stability across months.
TR_DATE falls within the archive-named month for all rows. Reporting dates extend into June for 16,242 May rows, August for 10 July rows, and September for 9,202 August rows.
July observed trade dates end on 2018-07-30. No claim of July 31 coverage or complete market-session coverage is made.

Transaction ID alone has 19 duplicate groups/19 extra rows in May, with differing full payloads. Custodian plus transaction ID is unique within each of these three files. No whole 19-field record duplicates were found.

July has four ISIN syntax-invalid rows, located at Sheet1!I14833, I14836, I21181 and I24981. All syntactically valid ISINs pass the checksum test in these files. This does not validate issuer identity.
Scrip names have frequent edge whitespace and many spelling variants per ISIN. No name canonicalization, identity promotion or corporate-action equivalence was applied.

Every RATE, QUANTITY and VALUE field is finite numeric. Values are nonnegative, with stored zero RATE and VALUE counts of 640 (May), 2,357 (July), and 1,024 (August). Quantities include fractional values in 64, 42 and 44 rows respectively; no integer-share convention is inferred.

All 346,084 rows have absolute VALUE-minus-RATE-times-QUANTITY residuals below 0.01 rupee. Exact source lexical decimal precision is retained; displayed rounding and monetary precision were not normalized.

All 48 package parts were consumed: 45 XML/relationship parts parsed and three printer-settings binaries hashed. There are no formula/error cells, hidden sheets/rows/columns, merged cells or external relationships in the observed packages.
